Sam: Quick prioritization thread  Optimize sprint choices: (1) Console live batching/cache hints, (2) eval-triggered regression alerts, (3) quantization recommendations. Pick two to focus this sprint?
Lee: my pick: 1 + 2. Hints = fast customer ROI. Alerts = trust/quality.
Anita: agree. Alerts need good debouncing and signal definitions or we'll be noisy.
Maya: customer feedback from AcmeHealth + Nimbus: alerts must be low FP and have "confirm" flow before wide notify.
Carlos: quant recs require benchmark infra + canary rollout plans. Recommend research spike only this sprint.
ops-bot: reminder: staging infra has limited eval runners this week.
Sam: propose concrete MVPs for scoping:
- Hints MVP: per-route batching suggestion (top-3 routes), one-click cache TTL preset, estimated token-cost delta, in-Console CTA to apply.
- Alerts MVP: eval-driven alerts (concordance drop OR embedding drift), feature-flagged, requires 2 consecutive failing runs to trigger, 24h quiet window, default to "confirm before notify".
Lee: rough sizing: Hints ~5-7 dev-days if limited to top3; Alerts ~7-10 if we reuse eval infra and add throttle.
Anita: signal thresholds proposal: concordance drop >=7% OR mean embedding cosine decrease >=0.06 across eval suite AND runs>=2. Add opt-in filters by route and model version.
Maya: will surface pilot customers and their acceptance criteria: FP <10%, clear remediation & rollback steps.
Carlos: SLI: false-positive alert rate <10% in pilot; also monitor alert-to-remediation time. Need rollback toggle in Console.
Sam: decision: prioritize Hints + slim Alerts behind FF. Quantization recs -> research spike next sprint. Any objections?
Lee: none. I'll create tickets: OPT-501 (console-batching-hints-top3), OPT-502 (cache-ttl-presets-cost-estimate), OPT-503 (eval-alerts-ff-pilot).
Anita: I'll author the signal spec doc and attach example eval configs. snippet for tests:
```
# pseudo-alert-config
alert_type: concordance_drop
threshold: 0.07
min_consecutive_runs: 2
quiet_window_hours: 24
notify_mode: confirmed_only
routes: ["/chat:default", "/summary:fast"]
```
Maya: I'll recruit AcmeHealth for pilot and send acceptance checklist.
Carlos: I'll draft monitoring dashboards and rollback playbook.
Sam: Actions: Lee tickets + PR plan, Anita signal doc + eval seeds, Maya pilot roster, Carlos SLI & rollback. Reconvene Tue for readiness check. :thumbsup:
